messages:
Nina (docs): Quick heads-up — I'm updating the model card rate limits section for Nebula3b. Need to swap the old per-second wording with per-minute examples + add an SDK snippet for backoff. Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/512
Raj (ml-eng): Thanks Nina. Are the rate numbers based on the Dedicated throughput profile or Hosted default?
Nina (docs): Hosted default. Using 60 req/min as an example bucket; also adding a batching example that shows how to set max_tokens_per_request in SDK.
Marta (runtime): FYI runtime changed the default bundling window, so examples should reflect `batch_window_ms: 20`. Otherwise the math is off.
Evan (SDK): I can add a short JS snippet. Proposed:
```js
const resp = await client.generate({
  model: 'nebula3b',
  input: '...',
  max_tokens: 256,
  batchConfig: { maxTokensPerRequest: 4096 }
})
```
Nina (docs): Perfect — put that in the migrations section. Also need to remove a broken internal link: /docs/old-rate-limits -> should point to /docs/rate-limits#model-cards.
CI-bot: build succeeded for PR 512 :white_check_mark: (lint + linkcheck)
Raj (ml-eng): One note: add a compat line about quantized variants which use different token accounting for embeddings. Keep it one sentence.
Nina (docs): Will do. Also adding a tiny benchmark table showing latency at 128/512 tokens for Hosted vs Dedicated to help readers choose defaults. Anyone willing to sanity-check numbers?
Marta (runtime): I'll run a quick perf check on Dedicated pool A this afternoon and paste results.
Evan (SDK): I'll update SDK types to include batchConfig and link the snippet in the SDK migration guide.
Nina (docs): OK assigning owners — @Marta runtime for numbers, @Evan SDK changes, @Raj ML for the quant note. I'll push a follow-up commit after numbers land in the PR. Thanks :thumbsup:
Raj (ml-eng): ack
Marta (runtime): ack
Evan (SDK): ack
